review_type: Independent read-only review of root-authored test correction

scope.existing_parameterizations: SyntheticRuntime and BlenderRuntime x desktop 1440x1000 and compact 390x844

checks: All three exact endpoint/method response and requestfinished waiters are entered before the corresponding click.

Installed Playwright _page._expect_event uses the existing page timeout when timeout is omitted. browser_page sets it to 20,000 ms. Both waiters are armed concurrently before clicking; this is not two sequential added twenty-second sleeps.
requestfinished is awaited on context exit before parsing response JSON, so body completion is observed before the UI projection budget starts.
Response predicates match exact POST URL without filtering success status; HTTP failure is not silently ignored. Clear and delete require 200; create requires 201.
Clear/delete validate returned request identity against actual submitted body, expected test identities and cleanup_pending false.
Create validates returned test identity against its submitted request UUID. TestRegistry.start explicitly derives test_id from request_id, so this check matches the product contract.

Each existing five-second UI assertion remains unchanged, as do cancellation, current-test selection, scenario retention, product restoration, revision, prior-evidence 404, no-physical-request, old/new command identity, journal effect count, world/catalog cleanup and fresh Test 1 checks.
The final fresh history test identity assertion is strengthened to equal the actual creation response while still excluding original.
No product dialog dismissal, busy lifetime, read drain, API, world freshness or robot timeout behavior is changed by this diff.

ast_assertion_comparison.replacement: The only removed assertion text is preserved as the tail of a stronger chained comparison binding the fresh ID to the returned ID.

native_probe_attribution.scope: Three unchanged-product native HTTP SyntheticRuntime clear cases before this test edit; not the browser regression.
native_probe_attribution.reported_results: Clear approximately 159-170 ms and projection reads 95-110 ms, normal initialization dominant, no retained server state/errors. Original 4.914-second delay not reproduced and cause remains unproven.
native_probe_attribution.source_limit: Only nine explicitly listed input hashes were bound at probe start/end, not the whole tree or the subsequently edited browser test.

validation_status.old_a881_acceptance: FAILED, preserved; test review does not promote it

limitations: Static source and exact-diff review only; no new browser, tests, runtime, network, DB or ZIP scan.
No claim that the new waits guarantee all UI projections meet five seconds; focused execution must establish that.
No product performance claim or root-cause attribution for the historical server delay.
The independent duplicate-select efficiency concern is intentionally unchanged.
